subject: Errors installing inlabru and fmesher packages

messages.author: 0c23c0b9755ba72c
messages.subject: Errors installing inlabru and fmesher packages
parts:
Dear R-INLA group,

I am trying to install inlabru and fmesher packages using the following code, but I receive error messages instead. Unfortunately, I don't know how to resolve.

# Install the fmesher package
library(devtools); install_bitbucket("finnlindgren/fmesher@default")
Installation failed: Couldn't resolve host name

# Install the inlabru 
devtools::install_git("https://github.com/fbachl/inlabru.git")
Downloading git repo https://github.com/fbachl/inlabru.git
Installation failed: Error in 'git2r_clone': failed to send request: The server name or address could not be resolved

Your help will be appreciated. My session info can be found below.

Regards,
Andronikos

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Re: Errors installing inlabru and fmesher packages
parts:
Thanks Finn. The following script setting up my work proxy seemed to overcome the internet connectivity issues. Installation worked for the femesher package but did not work for the inlabru package. It gives an error with the 'git2r_clone'? Any further advice?

Thank you,
Andronikos

install.packages("httr")
library(httr)
set_config(
  use_proxy(url="192.168.41.8", port=80)
)

# Install the fmesher package
library(devtools); install_bitbucket("finnlindgren/fmesher@default")

...
* DONE (fmesher)

# Install inlabru using
devtools::install_git("https://github.com/fbachl/inlabru.git")

Downloading git repo https://github.com/fbachl/inlabru.git
Installation failed: Error in 'git2r_clone': failed to send request: The server name or address could not be resolved
